records.source: 師範代しか持つことを許され{j}ぬ高級稽古用太刀。先革から{j}柄まで、非の打ち所無き逸品。
records.previous: A high-grade training Long Sword that only assistant instructors are permitted{j}to possess. From the tip leather to the{j}hilt, it is a flawless masterpiece.
records.target: Training Long Sword for instructors only.{j}Flawless from tip leather{j}to hilt.

records.source: 伝説の家具職人の魂が宿った{j}大槌。大人気の肉球仕掛けの{j}詳細は、企業秘密らしい。
records.previous: A Hammer{j}imbued with the soul of a legendary furniture craftsman. The details of the wildly popular paw-pad gadget{j}are apparently a company secret.
records.target: Hammer imbued with a legendary furniture{j}craftsman's soul. Its popular paw gadget's{j}details are a company secret.

records.source: 装飾を廃し、素材の持ち味を{j}最大限に引き出した大剣。{j}可能な限り加工した完成系。
records.previous: A Great Sword that forgoes decoration and draws out the material's inherent qualities{j}to the fullest.{j}A final form, processed to the greatest possible extent.
records.target: Great Sword forgoing decoration, drawing{j}out its material's full quality. Its final{j}form is meticulously processed.

records.source: ダークランスの究極進化形。{j}内部構造を一から見直して、神{j}経毒の注入効率を大幅に向上。
records.previous: Dark Lance's ultimate evolved form. The{j}internal structure was redesigned from scratch, greatly improving the injection efficiency of divine{j}neurotoxin.
records.target: Ultimate Dark Lance evolution.{j}Redesigned inside from scratch, greatly{j}improving divine neurotoxin injection.

records.source: 黒角竜の素材で強化した剛鎚。{j}逞しい黒角竜の突進を思わせ{j}る破壊力は、まさに覇者の力。
records.previous: A mighty hammer reinforced with Black Diablos materials.{j}Its destructive power, reminiscent of{j}a Black Diablos's powerful charge, is truly the power of a conqueror.
records.target: Mighty Black Diablos hammer.{j}Its charge-like destructive power.{j}The power of a conqueror.

records.source: 最先端の加工技術を結集し、{j}高い火属性と武器としての{j}威力を徹底追及した珠玉の槍。
records.previous: Bringing together cutting-edge processing technology,{j}High Fire element and, as a weapon,{j}A peerless lance that pursues raw power to the utmost.
records.target: Peerless lance built with cutting-edge.{j}High Fire element and weapon power pursued{j}to the utmost.

records.source: 伝説の金竜銀竜の素材を用い{j}た双剣。武器となった今なお{j}熱さを感じる貴重な武器。
records.previous: Dual Blades made using{j}materials from the legendary Gold Dragon and Silver Dragon. Even now as a weapon,{j}it is a precious weapon that still feels hot.
records.target: Dual Blades made from legendary Gold and{j}Silver Dragon materials. Even as a weapon,{j}they remain precious and hot.

records.source: 邪龍ミラボレアスを祀る神器。{j}〜大地の龍脈より命を受け{j}御神体の南門へ注ぐ者也〜
records.previous: A sacred treasure enshrining the Evil Dragon Fatalis.{j}~Granted its mission by the earth's dragon veins,{j}it pours into the South Gate of the divine body~
records.target: Sacred treasure enshrining Evil Fatalis.{j}~By earth's dragon veins ordained,{j}it flows to the South Gate.~

records.source: 極龍の力の象徴である磁力を{j}応用した片手剣。龍と麻痺の{j}双属性で、モンスターを狩れ。
records.previous: A Sword & Shield that applies the magnetism{j}symbolizing the Extreme Dragon's power. With its dual Dragon and Paralysis{j}attributes, hunt monsters.
records.target: Sword & Shield applying Extreme Dragon{j}magnetism. Dragon and Paralysis elements{j}let you hunt monsters.

records.source: 極龍の力の象徴である磁力を{j}応用した片手剣。龍と麻痺の{j}双属性で、畏れを薙ぎ払え！
records.previous: A Sword & Shield that applies the magnetism{j}symbolizing the Extreme Dragon's power. With its dual Dragon and Paralysis{j}attributes, mow down all fear!
records.target: Sword & Shield applying Extreme Dragon{j}magnetism. Dragon and Paralysis elements{j}mow down all fear!
